literature_proposed.summary: Known. The integral points of the elliptic curve 1611.a1 (y^2 + y = x^3 - 9x + 20) are a published computation: the LMFDB lists exactly the 22 in this node's conclusion, found from a Mordell–Weil basis by the elliptic-logarithm method. Not formalised: a Lean proof would need the Mordell–Weil group and a Baker-type bound. This node is the whole number-theoretic content of its parent; the parent's assembly, which maps the binomial equation onto this curve, is proved.
